title: Lutheran North Middle School
subtitle: Chicago, IL · April 30 – May 3, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing Lutheran North Middle School’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Travel to Chicago & the University of Chicago

  • Depart for Chicago
  • Stop en route for breaks/lunch
  • Meet your Landmark Leader in Chicago
  • Guided tour of the University of Chicago
  • Sit-down Dinner Included (Final Restaurant Based on Availability)
  • Return to hotel accommodations with overnight security (three nights)

Day 2: The University of Illinois, Pilsen & Navy Pier

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Guided tour of The University of Illinois
  • Lunch in the Pilsen Neighborhood
  • Student exploration in the Pilsen neighborhood
  • Visit the National Museum of Mexican Art
  • Student exploration of Millennium Park
  • Student exploration of Navy Pier
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: Science & Industry and the Obama Presidential Center

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry
  • Lunch at Sterling Food Hall
  • Visit the Museum at the Obama Presidential Center
  • Student exploration of the Magnificent Mile neighborhood
  • Sit-down Dinner Included (Final Restaurant Based on Availability)
  • Escape room at Fox in a Box
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 4: DePaul University

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Guided tour of DePaul University
  • College/University Dining Hall Lunch
  • Depart for home
introHeading: Lutheran North Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Chicago adventure in 2027! 🌆
introText: From the quadrangles of the University of Chicago to the murals of Pilsen, this trip brings the city’s history, art and college life to life at every turn. Students will tour four campuses, explore the National Museum of Mexican Art, the Griffin Museum of Science and Industry and the Museum at the Obama Presidential Center, and take in Millennium Park, Navy Pier and the Magnificent Mile. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
